name: Kurukshetra
source_label: Kurukshetra District Administration — Contact directory + Public Utility (LNJP Hospital) + Kurukshetra Police (kurukshetra.haryanapolice.gov.in)

fields.nearest_hospital: Lok Nayak Jai Prakash Narayan (LNJP) Civil Hospital, Kurukshetra

notes: LNJP Civil Hospital Kurukshetra (NOT 'Lala Lajpat Rai' as briefed — LNJP here = Lok Nayak Jai Prakash Narayan, the Hindi-language card on https://kurukshetra.gov.in/hi/public-utility/लोकनायक-जय-प्रकाश-नारायण/ confirms the namesake) is the district civil hospital, near KUK Railway Station Area, pincode 136118 — district civil hospital so ER true. PGIMS Rohtak (the state's main tertiary referral) is ~165 km away, not a realistic emergency-room option for Kurukshetra travellers — LNJP is the right anchor. City Kurukshetra Police Station (Thanesar) named per https://kurukshetra.haryanapolice.gov.in/PS_City — station-level phone seen on a 3rd-party listing as 070567 00123 but kept off payload (not on .gov.in). DC Office multi-line 01744-220270/220271/227777/220935 confirmed at https://kurukshetra.gov.in/contact-us/ — acts as district control / coordination. No dedicated district disaster-mgmt 1077-style line published on kurukshetra.gov.in. Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/guesthouse/EN-doctor not on any .gov.in/.nic.in page → null.

name: Morni Hills
source_label: Panchkula District Administration — Hospitals/CHCs/PHCs directory + Sub Division Hospital Kalka page + Contact-us + Panchkula Police (panchkula.haryanapolice.gov.in)
notes: Morni village itself has only PHC Morni (primary health centre, basic OPD-level — NOT a true ER). The closest govt facility with surgical/emergency capability is Sub Divisional Hospital Kalka — listed on https://panchkula.nic.in/public-utility/sub-division-hospital-kalka/ — sub-divisional hospital so ER true, ~30 km via Morni-Pinjore-Kalka road. General Hospital Sector-6 Panchkula (0172-2562199) is ~45 km and the next-step district referral. PHC Morni number (6239107893) and Kalka SDH number (9468188869) seen in directory listings but kept off payload — directory aggregators carry stale mobile numbers, life-safety risk too high. NO dedicated police station in Morni village — covered by Pinjore PS jurisdiction (Morni is in Pinjore tehsil/Kalka sub-division). DC Panchkula 0172-2585000/2568313 confirmed at https://panchkula.nic.in/contact-us/ — acts as district control/rescue coordinator (no separate 1077-style line published). Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/guesthouse/EN-doctor not on any .nic.in page → null. Trekkers should pre-load 112 (national emergency) + 108 (ambulance).

Address from https://panchkula.haryanapolice.gov.in/ps-Pinjore_htm. Station-level phone (01733-231403 + mobile 9729990502) seen on aggregators only — kept off payload (not on .haryanapolice.gov.in directly visible to me; timeouts blocked direct fetch). Sub Divisional Hospital Kalka (~5 km, on Kalka-Baddi Road) listed on https://panchkula.nic.in/public-utility/sub-division-hospital-kalka/ — sub-divisional hospital so ER true. PHC Pinjore (01733-230844 per directory listings) is closer (~1 km) but primary-care only, no surgical ER → SDH Kalka is the right anchor. General Hospital Sector-6 Panchkula (0172-2562199) is ~20 km, next-step referral. DC Panchkula 0172-2585000/2568313 from https://panchkula.nic.in/contact-us/. Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/guesthouse/EN-doctor not on any .nic.in page → null.
